    need(path.is_absolute() and path == path.resolve() and not path.is_symlink(), 'canonical DATA path')
    info = path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and (0 if empty else 1) <= info.st_size <= cap
